newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway stocks power ahead to new record territory.
newsitem.headline: Norway stocks power ahead to new record territory.

text.p: Norwegian shares stormed to new highs in heavy turnover on Monday in catch up with a strong pre-weekend Wall Street and further gains when the U.S. market opened.
Brokers said the Oslo bourse was expected to continue in a positive trend although at a slower pace than recent developments.
The Total share index gained more than 1.5 percent to hit the 11th all-time record closing high this year at 1,044.43. Turnover was a bumper 1,23 billion crowns.

The market remained focused on the crown, which climbed to fresh 52-week highs against the mark. But analysts said the crown's relentless appreciation -- more than 10 percent against the mark since August -- may have left it exposed to corrective pressures. The bubble could burst soon, they said.
The strong crown has had a negative impact on some export-oriented shares but has been a positive influence for the consumer sector.
Food-based conglomerate Orkla advanced 21 crowns, or 4.17 percent to end at 525 crowns in the A share. The stock has jumped 10 percent from 477 crowns last Monday.
